decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The crossover shall not exceed a width of 2.4m.

Condition : 4 - Before the development is first utilised a pedestrian visibility splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided either side of the access way with nothing over 600mm in this area (other than the vertical bars supporting the gate). The wall shall be reduced to a height of 600mm at a distance of 2.4m either side of the entrance. This visibility splay shall be permanently retained.
Condition : 5 - Before the development is first brought into use, the wall/fence is to be reinstated and permanently retained, in accordance with the preceding condition.
description: Formation of a means of access to house.
